item.title: Trump Calls for Investigation into GDP Revision
item.description: President Donald Trump has requested an inquiry into the recent upward revision of third-quarter GDP figures. He characterized the adjustment as a significant error.

item.title: Semiconductor Exports Surpass Oil and Gas in 2026
item.description: The global demand for artificial intelligence technology has driven chip exports to record levels. This shift marks the first time semiconductor shipments have exceeded those of oil and gas.

item.title: Banks Secure Debt Financing for KKR's Logoplaste Acquisition
item.description: Financial institutions have arranged €550 million in loans to support KKR & Co.'s purchase of Logoplaste. The deal involves significant debt backing for the packaging firm.

item.title: Kazakhstan Supports Local Financing for Gold Mine Acquisition
item.description: Kazakhstan has encouraged domestic banks to provide over $1 billion in loans to facilitate a private acquisition of AK Altynalmas JSC. Regulatory changes were implemented to assist the buyer, Shakhmurat Mutalip.

item.title: Wall Street Futures Rise Ahead of Black Friday
item.description: U.S. stock futures are trending upward as global markets react positively to signs of economic resilience. This follows a recovery for the S&P 500 after recent volatility in the technology sector.

item.title: Altria and Japan Tobacco Consider Imperial Brands Bid
item.description: Altria Group and Japan Tobacco are evaluating a potential acquisition of Imperial Brands. This move could represent one of the largest UK takeovers in recent years within the tobacco industry.

item.title: Hedge Funds Prioritize Capital Preservation Amid Volatility
item.description: Hedge funds are shifting their strategy toward protecting existing assets following a performance decline in the second half of the year. Goldman Sachs anticipates this defensive posture will continue.

item.title: Oil prices climb following Houthi attacks on Saudi ports
item.description: Crude oil prices increased as Houthi rebels targeted Saudi Arabian infrastructure. Attacks were reported at a refinery in Ras Tanura and ports in Jeddah and Jazan.

item.title: US tariff plan creates pressure for India trade deal
item.description: The US has proposed a 17% tariff on Indian goods, which could rise to 25% if a trade deal is not reached. This policy creates uncertainty for investors and exporters.

item.title: TH International explores potential stake sale for Tim Hortons China
item.description: TH International Ltd. is evaluating strategic options for its Tim Hortons business in Greater China. A potential sale of a stake in the operations is currently being considered.

item.title: Proposed US tariffs may provide competitive edge to India
item.description: New US tariff proposals target several Asian nations with levies ranging from 18% to 20%. These measures could improve the relative trade position of India against regional competitors.

item.title: Court halts FCC early license renewal for Disney-owned ABC stations
item.description: A judge has issued a temporary block on the FCC's early license renewal process for ABC stations. The decision is being framed as a legal victory regarding First Amendment concerns.

item.title: S&P Global Ratings considers lowering Nvidia credit rating
item.description: S&P Global Ratings indicated a potential one-notch downgrade for Nvidia. The move follows concerns regarding management and governance practices at the company.

item.title: Market analysts suggest stock selloff may persist
item.description: Recent market gains are viewed as insufficient to address underlying structural issues. Further volatility could occur before a stable market floor is established.

item.title: Asia-Pacific Stocks Poised to Rise as US Markets Rebound
item.description: Regional bourses in the Asia-Pacific were positioned to advance on Thursday morning. The anticipated upward movement followed an overnight turnaround on Wall Street from its session lows.

item.title: Crude Maintains Two-Day Advance Amid Middle East Conflict
item.description: Crude oil preserved its two-day price advance on November 26 as regional tensions persisted. Ongoing hostilities across the Middle East presented risks to the recovery of local petroleum shipments.

item.title: Oracle and CoreWeave Rebound Following Wednesday Morning Slump
item.description: Technology shares including Oracle and CoreWeave recovered from early-session deficits on Wednesday. The broader market selloff diminished in intensity as trading approached the final bell.

item.title: Nvidia Erases Bulk of Monday Rally as Dip Buyers Take Profits
item.description: Shares of Nvidia relinquished a large portion of Monday's advance following profit-taking by dip buyers. Research firm Vanda Research noted that retail investors who purchased shares on the dip last week have seen their gains largely disappear.

item.title: Asian Stocks Point Higher Following Wall Street's Late Recovery
item.description: Equities across Asia were slated for modest advances after a late-session turnaround on Wall Street prevented the Nasdaq 100 from entering a bear market. Meanwhile, persistent uncertainty regarding artificial intelligence investments provided support to US Treasuries.

item.title: Elon Musk and SpaceX to distribute shares to 'Trump accounts'
item.description: SpaceX plans to issue Class A shares to active 'Trump accounts' as part of a donation initiative. CEO Elon Musk intends to match the value of these gifts.

item.title: HP shares rise following earnings report
item.description: HP stock outperformed during a broader technology sector decline. The gains were supported by a positive earnings result despite characterizations of the beat as low-quality.

item.title: SpaceX Secures FCC Clearance for 1 Million Orbital Data Satellites
item.description: The Federal Communications Commission granted SpaceX authorization to place 1 million orbital data center satellites in space. The initiative had faced objections during the regulatory process from Amazon alongside other entities.

item.title: Rising Costs Impact U.S. Holiday Spending Plans
item.description: American households are adjusting their holiday budgets due to increased expenses for travel, food, and gifts. Inflation and energy price shocks linked to the war in Iran are cited as contributing factors.

item.title: PCE Inflation Gauge Reaches 3.8% in October
item.description: The personal consumption expenditures price index met expectations for an annual inflation rate of 3.8% in October. This reading aligns with the Dow Jones consensus forecast.

item.title: U.S. Proposes New Tariffs on 14 Trading Partners
item.description: The United States government has proposed new levies targeting 14 different trading partners. These measures are intended to address trade practices viewed as discriminatory or burdensome.

item.title: Rising Inflation Expectations Point to Fed Rate Hike
item.description: The Federal Reserve's preferred inflation measure accelerated in October. This trend suggests the central bank will likely increase borrowing costs in the coming month.

item.title: U.S. Proposes New Tariffs Following Court Ruling
item.description: The U.S. government is pursuing new trade levies against China and other nations. This action follows a Supreme Court decision earlier this year that invalidated previous, broader tariff measures.

item.title: Nvidia Faces Regulatory Risks Following CEO Return
item.description: Nvidia shares declined as investors weighed the legal and regulatory implications of Jensen Huang's return. The company now faces heightened scrutiny within the broader artificial intelligence sector.

item.title: Tech Stocks Decline as Markets Await PCE Data
item.description: U.S. equity futures are lower as investors question the outlook for the artificial intelligence sector. Meanwhile, Treasuries have rallied in anticipation of the upcoming PCE inflation report.

item.title: European Gas Markets Face Volatile Winter Outlook
item.description: Low supply buffers and geopolitical instability in the Middle East are expected to drive volatility in European gas markets. Shifting weather forecasts further complicate the supply outlook.
